map.title: Dewhollow pixel32 map and tileset candidate

source.method: hand-authored integer pixel primitives; fixed stored-DEFLATE PNG encoding

limitations: Candidate preview only; not approved or registered as production assets.
Seasonal variants and autotile masks are hand-authored visual studies, not production game map rules.
Building and canopy demonstrate layer ordering and do not alter collision or map data.
Final colors, tile readability, seamless edges, building silhouette, and mobile readability require Gate 1 human review.

animation.title: Dewhollow pixel32 four-direction animation candidate
limitations: Candidate art and motion only; not approved or registered as production assets.
Right-facing frames mirror left-facing poses; Gate 1 visual review must confirm silhouette and foot contact.
The preview tool overlay demonstrates timing only and does not change farming rules.
Chromium emulation only; no native iOS or Android evidence.
This records walk-frame timing and numeric depth ordering, not pixel-perfect occlusion quality or artistic approval.
The full 12x10 game scene, exact candidate approval, and Gate 1 sign-off remain pending.
